title: 캘리포니아...산타페
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad. A nylon-string acoustic guitar plays arpeggiated chords with prominent finger-slide noise. A legato string section provides harmonic support with sustained cello and violin lines. A soft, breathy male baritone vocal delivers a melodic performance with frequent vibrato. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the acoustic guitar and the vocal. 72 BPM, 4/4 time signature, Key of C Major.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[arpeggiated nylon-string acoustic guitar]

[Verse 1]
[breathy male vocals]
오늘 비가 내리는 오후였어
창가에 앉아서 봤어 [strings enter softly]
커피 한 잔이 식어 가고 있었어
창가에 빗방울이 맺혀 있어
흘러내리다가 [acoustic guitar continues arpeggios]
